en: WASD: move · Shift: run · Space: jump · Click: control camera · Wheel: zoom · Esc: release mouse

en: Left stick: move · R2: run · X/□: jump · Right stick: camera · L1/R1: zoom

en: Joystick: move (push to the edge to run) · Drag on the right: camera
